top_signals.title: Gold Slumps as Faster US Inflation Stokes Fed Rate Hike Wagers
top_signals.summary: Gold slumped after US consumer prices jumped the most in five months, reigniting worries that the Federal Reserve will need to raise interest rates further to combat inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
